Asserts HTTP 200 and verifies that the backend created the sentinel file /var/tmp/preserveconfig.flag, which is consumed downstream by the flash area preparation routine (PrepareFlashArea) to preserve BMC configuration across the firmware update.

When the flash area has already been prepared in a prior request, a subsequent PUT /api/maintenance/flash call must recognise the prepared state and return HTTP 200 without re-executing PrepareFlashArea, preventing redundant flash area initialisation. The backend treats ALREADY_PREPARED_ERROR as success.

test.doc: Full end-to-end regression test for WH3-1205. Simulates the complete WebUI HPM firmware upgrade flow: 1. PUT /api/maintenance/flash with preserve_config=0 to prepare flash area. 2. Assert HTTP 200 on the first packet — the exact transaction that previously halted with HTTP 500 due to the missing payload field. 3. Initiate HPM image upload to confirm the pipeline progresses past the initial preparation stage without aborting. This is the primary regression guard confirming the WH3-1205 fix is effective for both upgrade and downgrade scenarios on AST2600 dual-flash.

suite.doc: Dual-Flash WebUI Upgrade & REST API Suite Covers WH3-1205: WebUI HPM Firmware Upgrade Failure Investigation & Fix. Validates root-cause fixes for missing preserve_config payload, string-to-integer type mismatches in REST endpoints, backend INT8U casting, dual-flash image config, flash-area prepared guard, and full end-to-end HPM upgrade regression.
